instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to describe how a house is built.

atoms.b: First, a construction worker pours the ((++concrete_foundation)).
Next, a ((++bricklayer)) builds the walls of the house out of bricks, which are firmly stuck together with ((++mortar)).
Carpenters construct a ((++wooden)) frame called a roof truss on top of the walls.
Then, a ((++roofer)) covers the roof with tiles.
Another ((++carpenter)) makes frames for the windows and doors.
A ((++window_fitter)) cuts the window panes to be fitted into these frames. The window is then built into the wall.
An ((++electrician)) lays cables and installs plug sockets and light switches.
A ((++plumber)) lays metal ((++pipes)) and connects them to sinks, toilets and ((++radiators)).
Finally, a ((++painter_and_decorator)) wallpapers and paints the walls and ((++ceilings)) in every room.
